disadvantages: Large file handling puts strain on the application tier
Adding new integrations requires redeployment of the application tier

components.name: BrowserSPA
responsibilities: Browser-based UI for data room management, file upload/download, and PDF collaboration
Client-side E2E encryption and decryption with user's SecuPass key
Drag-and-drop upload interface and PDF annotation viewer

components.name: ApplicationAPI
responsibilities: REST API endpoints for all client operations
Input validation and request routing
Orchestrates calls to domain modules
Session management and token handling

components.name: SecurityModule
responsibilities: Authentication
Authorisation
SecuPass validation for E2E-encrypted data rooms

components.name: DataRoomModule
responsibilities: Create, rename, describe, and delete data rooms
Manage hierarchical folder structure within data rooms
Configure deletion deadlines per data room
Assign and change user roles within a data room
Enforce room-level encryption settings

components.name: FileModule
responsibilities: Handle file upload, download, move, rename, and delete operations
Manage file versioning and version history
Trigger virus scanning on upload

components.name: UserModule
responsibilities: Manage user accounts
Handle email-based invitations to data rooms
Administer SecuPass setup and storage reference

components.name: AuditLogger
responsibilities: Record all file uploads, downloads, views, deletions, and permission changes
Capture user identity and timestamp for every logged event
Provide audit trail retrieval for data room owners and admins
Support DSGVO retention and compliance reporting

components.name: NotificationModule
responsibilities: Send email notifications for new uploads, changes, and permission events
Send advance warnings before data room deletion deadlines

components.name: AdminConsole
responsibilities: Web interface for platform administrators
Overview of all data rooms
Assign and revoke owner rights across data rooms
Manage global settings and group permissions

components.name: MetadataDB
responsibilities: Store data room metadata, folder structure, user accounts, roles, and group definitions
Manage file versioning records and deletion deadline configurations

components.name: ObjectStorage
responsibilities: Store encrypted file content
Support large file storage up to 100 GB per file
Provide chunked upload and download APIs
Enforce data residency in German data centres

components.name: AuditLogStore
responsibilities: Support compliance queries and report generation

components.name: VirusScanner
responsibilities: Scan uploaded files for malware before making them accessible to users
Log scan results

components.name: IdentityProvider
responsibilities: External SSO authentication source
2FA token validation

components.name: ExternalMailService
responsibilities: Deliver email notifications to users

infrastructure.name: AppServerCluster
infrastructure.details: Horizontally scaled cluster running ApplicationAPI and all domain modules; stateless application tier allows session tokens to be validated on any node

infrastructure.name: DBCluster
infrastructure.details: PostgreSQL HA cluster with synchronous replication and automatic failover; all data stored in German data centres

infrastructure.name: ObjectStorageCluster
infrastructure.details: Object storage with AES-256 GCM encryption; supports chunked uploads for files up to 100 GB; geographically constrained to Germany

infrastructure.name: TLSTermination
infrastructure.details: TLS termination at load balancer for all client-to-server traffic
